title: Malicious code in @charape/baileys (npm)
description: The @charape/baileys npm package contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise may lead to full control of the affected system by an outside entity. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys stored on the compromised computer is advised. Removal of the package is recommended, but it may not fully eliminate the malicious software due to potential persistent control.
